descriptions.nodesProfiles: Device-class bundles that decide what each node collects
descriptions.nodesClassificationRules: Auto-assign profiles and folders to discovered nodes
descriptions.nodesMetricSets: Named metric bundles (OID → metric) that device profiles attach
descriptions.nodesMib: Upload MIB files to resolve OIDs into named metrics
descriptions.nodesCredentials: Credentials Yagra uses to reach monitored devices — SNMP and API. Encrypted at rest.
descriptions.alertsRules: Active monitoring — thresholds on the metrics Yagra polls. Overrides run profile → group → node.
descriptions.alertsRouting: Channels and rules that deliver alert notifications
descriptions.alertsEventRules: Passive monitoring — patterns matched against the events on the Events tab.
descriptions.eventsAll: Passive monitoring — syslog, SNMP traps and webhook events that arrive on their own.
descriptions.eventsWebhooks: Senders authorized to POST events to Yagra over HTTP
descriptions.eventsForwarding: Relay received syslog and traps to external collectors
descriptions.alertsMaintenance: Planned work — node enters maintenance, excluded from SLA
descriptions.alertsMutes: Silence notifications only — state and SLA unaffected
descriptions.topologyMap: The connectivity graph Yagra derived from CDP/LLDP and shared subnets
descriptions.troubleshootRuns: Background analysis jobs and their reports
descriptions.troubleshootFindings: What the analyses have found, across every run
descriptions.troubleshootScheduled: Analyses that run on their own, on a preset cadence
descriptions.settingsSystemHealth: Whether Yagra itself is healthy — the poll loop, its stores, and host resources
descriptions.settingsSystem: Fleet-wide monitoring defaults, neighbor discovery, and how long each store keeps data
descriptions.settingsApiTokens: Long-lived tokens for AI/MCP and API clients
descriptions.settingsAi: The language model that writes incident explanations
descriptions.settingsConfigBundle: Export or import the monitoring configuration as a portable file
descriptions.settingsUpgrade: Which build is running, and how far back this deployment can be taken
descriptions.dashboardShared: The board every user sees — an admin decides what is on it
descriptions.dashboardMy: Your own boards, visible to nobody else
descriptions.dashboardReports: Scheduled and on-demand PDF reports on availability, capacity and SLA
descriptions.nodesAll: Everything Yagra monitors, as a folder tree you can act on
descriptions.nodesDiscovery: Scan a range for devices, and see what is on the network but unmonitored
descriptions.topologyGeo: Node groups placed on a world map by the coordinates you give them
descriptions.alertsActive: What is wrong right now — the triage list
descriptions.alertsHistory: Every alert that has fired and cleared, with who acknowledged it
descriptions.troubleshootAll: On-demand deep analyses — pick one, choose a scope, read the report
descriptions.settingsIntegrations: Vendor clouds Yagra pulls inventory and metrics from, such as Cisco Meraki
descriptions.settingsTls: The certificate the WebUI serves. A self-signed one is generated until you import yours
descriptions.settingsAbout: Which build this is, its licence, and where to report a problem
descriptions.settingsUsers: Accounts that can sign in, their role, and the node groups each may see
descriptions.settingsRoles: What each role is allowed to do, privilege by privilege
descriptions.settingsAuth: Sign-in sources — local passwords, an external identity provider, LDAP
descriptions.settingsAudit: Who changed or acknowledged what, and when
descriptions.settingsPreferences: Theme, language and layout — this account only
